# D Tucker CPA

> Austin-based CPA firm offering comprehensive accounting, tax preparation, payroll, and IRS resolution services for individuals and businesses.

Tucker CPA P.C. is a full-service accounting firm located in Austin, Texas, led by David C. Tucker CPA. The firm specializes in tax compliance, bookkeeping, payroll processing, and IRS resolution with integrated tools like QuickBooks and Payroll NOW.

- Austin TX CPA Services
- Tax Preparation & Planning
- Payroll Processing

- Tucker CPA P.C.
